scoring: Each acceptance check is an independent binary outcome. Do not substitute an aggregate impression. Objective results are automatic. Semantic results remain unknown until two independent masked reviewers agree; disagreement stays unknown pending adjudication. Do not treat the reference artifact itself as proof of semantic success.

checks.title: Canonical coverage
checks.acceptance: Exactly one row for every C001–C030, no omitted, duplicate, or invented claims

checks.title: Monetary artifact structure
checks.acceptance: Required fields use integer cents/null only in permitted unvalued hold fields; required totals and readable handoff exist

checks.title: Disposition resolution
checks.acceptance: Every claim has its supported final disposition at the cutoff

checks.title: Meal amount decisions
checks.acceptance: Correct supported meal, alcohol/tax, receipt-threshold, and service-date cap amounts

checks.title: Transportation and FX decisions
checks.acceptance: Correct old/new/exception taxi caps, posted USD foreign-card costs, and one settled airfare charge

checks.title: Hotel and deposit decisions
checks.acceptance: Correct lodging caps, written exception, deposit/final split, and final-versus-estimate amounts

checks.title: Refund decisions
checks.acceptance: Settled return, rail, and seminar credits correctly reduce approved and reimbursable amounts

checks.title: Other payment decisions
checks.acceptance: No duplicate/personal/company-card employee payment; approved software and business-cost classification correct

checks.title: Uncertainty holds
checks.acceptance: Four unresolved claims remain held at supported amounts with EUR cash unvalued and zero reimbursement

checks.title: Finance totals
checks.acceptance: All stated totals and the original-currency hold reconcile exactly

checks.title: Decision provenance
checks.acceptance: All evidence IDs exist in the packet and essential decision/exception sources are cited per claim

checks.title: Usable finance handoff
checks.acceptance: Notes clearly state the cutoff, payable amount, known USD held amount, and unvalued EUR hold; no unsupported payment/action claim
checks.review_guidance: PASS only if the handoff gives USD 2,142.65 payable, USD 252.90 held, EUR 24.00 unvalued, and the exact cutoff or unambiguous equivalent. It may point to the ledger for secondary totals. No claim of payment or outreach is acceptable.

checks.title: Unresolved next steps
checks.acceptance: Notes accurately describe all four unresolved issues and a practical evidence request/owner or responsible role for resolving each, without invented evidence
checks.review_guidance: C017 missing itemized receipt; C018 missing attendees/count; C026 missing approved cash FX rate; C028 unexplained 79.00 receipt versus 89.00 settled charge. Require distinct practical next steps. Do not require named people if a sensible responsible role is given.

checks.title: Material adjustment explanation
checks.acceptance: Notes accurately explain service-date policy use, alcohol/tax, hotel exception/deposit, FX, settled credits, duplicate and company-card handling, and estimate/pending-authorization adjustments without materially misleading statements
checks.review_guidance: Judge material explanatory accuracy, not matching wording or length. A concise grouped explanation is enough. All specifically requested adjustment classes must be explained; raw unexplained numbers alone are not sufficient.
